tasks.description: In adt-console/src/js/terminal.js, activate() sets entry._justActivated=true to suppress the second SIGWINCH in show(). But show() clears _justActivated inside setTimeout(100ms). If a second show() fires before that 100ms expires, the guard is already consumed and Gemini gets a double-SIGWINCH mid-TUI-draw, blanking the terminal. Fix: use a timestamp-based guard instead of a boolean — store _activatedAt=Date.now() in activate(), and in show() skip syncSize if Date.now()-entry._activatedAt < 300.
